newsitem.title: INDIA: Air-India initial study on aircraft purchase ready.
newsitem.headline: Air-India initial study on aircraft purchase ready.

text.p: A committee appointed by Air-India submitted its preliminary report on purchase of aircraft valued at over $2.0 billion planned by the national carrier, a spokesman said on Tuesday.
"The sub-committee appointed by the board submitted its interim report," the spokesman said. "The board will now co-opt a finance person for final negotiations," he said.
He did not reveal the contents of the interim report and said the date for final negotiations had not been set.
Air-India plans to buy over 20 aircraft at a cost of over $2.0 billion. Three contenders who made presentations to Air-India management are Airbus Industrie, Boeing Company and McDonnell Douglas.
